info.title: Warehouse Management System API
info.description: REST API for the warehouse-backend-cpp service

example: Password must be at least 8 characters long

post.description: Аутентификация пользователя и получение токенов доступа

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new product in the system. Requires admin or manager role.

400.description: Invalid product data or SKU already exists

get.description: Retrieves a specific product by its ID. Requires authentication.

403.description: Forbidden - insufficient permissions or product not active

put.description: Updates an existing product. Requires admin or manager role.

400.description: Invalid product data or SKU already exists

delete.description: Deletes (deactivates) a product. Requires admin or manager role.

400.description: Invalid product ID or cannot delete due to dependencies

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of orders with optional filtering

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by order status (new, processing, picked, packed, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Filter by priority (low, normal, high, urgent)

post.description: Create a new customer order with order items

get.description: Retrieve a specific order with its items by ID

403.description: Forbidden - insufficient permissions to view this order

put.description: Update order information (Note: Method not supported - use specific endpoints for updating order status or priority)

delete.description: Delete or cancel an order (cancels if not shipped)

400.description: Invalid order ID or order cannot be cancelled

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive order statistics. Requires ADMIN, MANAGER or AUDITOR role.
Generate revenue report for a specified date range. Requires ADMIN, MANAGER or AUDITOR role.
Retrieve order history for a specific customer by email. Requires ADMIN, MANAGER or AUDITOR role.

400.description: Bad request - missing or invalid email

post.description: Creates a new category. Requires admin or manager permissions.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of categories. Supports filtering by parentId.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

get.description: Retrieves a specific category by its ID.

put.description: Updates an existing category. Requires admin or manager permissions.

delete.description: Deletes a category. Admin can delete any category, manager can only delete empty categories (no products or subcategories).

forceDelete.description: Force delete even if category has products/subcategories (admin only)

400.description: Cannot delete category (contains products or subcategories)

get.description: Retrieve statistics for categories. Can be global statistics or for a specific category if categoryId parameter is provided.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Optional category ID to get statistics for a specific category. If not provided, returns global statistics.

404.description: Category not found (if specific categoryId is provided)

get.description: Возвращает список всех поставщиков с поддержкой пагинации и фильтрации
Возвращает информацию о конкретном поставщике
Возвращает статистическую информацию о поставщиках. Требуются права администратора, менеджера или аудитора.

parameters.name: supplierId
parameters.description: ID поставщика для получения статистики по конкретному поставщику (опционально)

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all payments. Requires admin, manager or auditor role.

post.description: Creates a new payment record. Requires admin, manager or worker role.

get.description: Retrieves a payment by its ID. Requires admin, manager or auditor role.

put.description: Updates an existing payment. Requires admin or manager role.

delete.description: Deletes a payment. Requires admin or manager role.

get.description: Возвращает сводную статистику по всем платежам. Доступно только для администраторов, менеджеров и аудиторов.
Генерирует детализированный отчет по платежам за указанный период. Доступно только для администраторов, менеджеров и аудиторов.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Дата начала периода (YYYY-MM-DD). По умолчанию: 30 дней назад

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Дата окончания периода (YYYY-MM-DD). По умолчанию: сегодня

by_payment_method.description: Распределение по методам оплаты за период

total_amount.description: Общая сумма всех платежей в периоде

post.description: Creates a new product batch in the system. Requires authentication and appropriate permissions.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of product batches with optional filtering.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term for batch number, product name, or SKU

200.description: List of product batches retrieved successfully

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific product batch.

put.description: Updates an existing product batch. Only admin and manager roles can update batches.

delete.description: Deletes a product batch. Only admin role can delete batches. Batch must have zero available quantity.

400.description: Cannot delete batch with non-zero available quantity

get.description: Retrieve statistics about product batches. Only accessible to admin, manager, and auditor roles.
Generate a report of expiring product batches. Only accessible to admin, manager, and auditor roles.
Generate a report of product batches by quality status. Only accessible to admin, manager, and auditor roles.

post.description: Создает новую отгрузку для указанного заказа

get.description: Возвращает список отгрузок с пагинацией и фильтрацией
Возвращает детальную информацию об отгрузке по ID
Получение статистической информации по отгрузкам. Доступно только для администраторов, менеджеров и аудиторов.

trendPercentage.description: Процентное изменение по сравнению с прошлым месяцем

get.description: Получение отчета по эффективности работы различных перевозчиков. Доступно только для администраторов, менеджеров и аудиторов.

parameters.name: minShipments
parameters.description: Минимальное количество отгрузок для включения в отчет

get.description: Детальный анализ стоимости доставки по различным параметрам. Доступно только для администраторов, менеджеров и аудиторов.

group.description: Группа анализа (перевозчик, метод доставки и т.д.)

post.description: Clears all items from a warehouse cell, making it empty. Requires admin or manager permissions.

reason.description: Optional reason for clearing the cell

400.description: Bad request - invalid cell ID or cell cannot be cleared

post.description: Creates a new warehouse cell with the provided data. Requires admin or manager permissions.

errors: Cell code must be between 1 and 50 characters

example.message: You don't have permission to create warehouse cells

get.description: Retrieves a list of warehouse cells with optional filtering and pagination. Requires authentication.
Retrieves a specific warehouse cell by its ID. Requires authentication.

put.description: Updates an existing warehouse cell. Requires admin or manager permissions.

errors: Max volume must be greater than 0
At least one field must be provided for update

example.message: You don't have permission to update this warehouse cell

delete.description: Deletes a warehouse cell. Requires admin permissions.

example.message: You don't have permission to delete this warehouse cell

get.summary: Get available warehouse cells for storage
get.description: Returns list of available warehouse cells that can store items with specified volume and weight requirements

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Minimum weight capacity required for storage

get.description: Returns detailed statistics about warehouse cells occupancy, status, and usage. Requires admin, manager, or auditor role.

cells_by_temperature_zone.description: Breakdown of cells by temperature zone

403.description: Insufficient permissions (requires admin, manager, or auditor role)

get.description: Returns detailed occupancy report for all warehouse cells including capacity utilization and status distribution. Requires admin, manager, or auditor role.

schema.description: Whether to include detailed cell-by-cell information

is_available.description: Whether cell is available for storage

report.description: Detailed occupancy report for each cell

total_cells.description: Total number of cells in report

average_occupancy_rate.description: Average occupancy rate across all cells

403.description: Insufficient permissions (requires admin, manager, or auditor role)

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of inventory movements with optional filters
Retrieve a specific inventory movement by its ID

post.description: Create a new receipt movement for receiving products from suppliers

put.description: Update the status of an existing inventory movement

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive inventory statistics including stock levels, value, movement counts, etc. Requires admin, manager, or auditor role.
Retrieve statistics about inventory movements (receipts, transfers, adjustments, shipments). Requires admin, manager, or auditor role.
Generate a detailed report of inventory movements with filtering options. Requires admin, manager, or auditor role.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Filter by user who performed the movement

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users. Administrators see all users, others see only active users.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Admin can create any user, manager can create workers and auditors.

get.description: Retrieves user details by ID. Users can view their own data, admin can view any user, manager can view workers and auditors.

put.description: Updates user information. Users can update their own profile (except role), admin can update any user, manager can update workers and auditors.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user. Admin can delete any user, manager can delete workers and auditors. Users cannot delete themselves.

post.description: Searches users by query string (username, email, full name). Parameters in query string.

additionalFilters.description: Optional additional filters in JSON format

get.description: Retrieves user statistics (total users, active/inactive counts, etc.). Only admin can view statistics.

newUsersThisWeek.description: Number of users created this week

newUsersThisMonth.description: Number of users created this month
